Strings.AudioGuide:
.pk and .hpk — BAO banks. Headings indicate the identity, duration and location of the sound.
.spk — Can carry sound blocks pointed by other banks.
.lpk and .lhpk — Bank or link files in the language folder.
.bik — Video. The audio channels in it can be extracted into separate WAV files.

Open a sound folder and select a bank. Double-click a track to preview it. Use the extraction buttons to save WAV or Ogg files.

Replace audio and Import audio folder queue changes for preview. WAV files are converted to the original channel count and sample rate. Overwrite current audio bank backs up the original packages before updating them. Save audio bank as creates a separate copy with the names you choose.

Strings.EditorHelp:
Load original English — Opens the embedded GRP English.
Open reference INF — Opens a readable .inf file of another language.
Both buttons load the read-only reference on the left and the editable copy on the right.
Save — Prompts for the target file on first save, then updates the same file. Ctrl+S.
Save as — Selects a new target file. Ctrl+Shift+S.
Find — Searches for code or text. Go to the search box with Ctrl+F.
Previous / Next — Navigates through editable rows.
F2 / double-click target cell — Opens inline editing.
Enter — Moves to the next target line and selects all text.
Esc — Closes the inline box. The arrangements made are preserved.
F1 — This opens the help window.

You can edit the target directly in the row or in the box at the bottom right.
Type \n for an in-game line break. Preserve placeholders like %s and {0}.
Both operations in the file conversion tab use the embedded Oasis key.
The Audio packets tab displays BAO content, extracts audio, and produces a packet copy.
